messages:
kevin: Quick async check — where are we on the Dedicated buildout? Need three short bullets for the exec slide by EOD: GPU procurement ETA, rack power sign-off status, and who owns the canary plan. We committed ~40 H100 slots for Q2.

maria: Procurement update: vendor (NimbleTech) confirmed PO accepted. Shipments split: 20 units ETA week of 2026-04-12, remaining 20 ETA mid-May. Customs hold risk flagged for one container (tracking: NT-PO-9982). I put the tentative arrival windows in the shared sheet.

alex: Rack/power status: data center approved PDUs but we still need the dual-feed power runs completed on Racks 14-16. Ops scheduled a 2-day window (maintenance ticket ENGINFRA-457) starting 2026-04-09. Without the feeds we can stage hardware but can't power all nodes.

sara: Canary ownership: I can own the canary rollout. Plan is: 1) smoke tests with a single rack, 2) perf soak (48h) on dedicated pool, 3) gradual traffic ramp using routing policy. Need infra PR merged + capacity reservations confirmed.

chris: Infra PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 — small tf change + new instance profile. @maria can you confirm reserved capacity numbers? I can review the PR today, ping me if you want a quick pairing.

maria: Reserving 40 slots total (40x H100-80GB equiv) — but we should keep 8 for canary + 32 for GA traffic. I'll update reservations in the RB sheet and trigger ops-bot.

ops-bot: Reservation updated: 40 H100 slots reserved under account: redwood-dedicated-prod. Reference: RESV-2026-0412.

kevin: Perfect. @sara, once PR merged and power window confirmed can you draft the canary playbook (smoke cmds, metrics to watch, rollback steps)? Keep it short — one pager.

sara: Yep, will do. Draft by tomorrow morning and link it here.

chris: Quick note on the PR: local test command I used: `TF_LOG=info terraform plan -var='count=4'` — validated the instance profile mapping. Will run apply in staging after review.

alex: Also flagging cooling: our design target is 8kW per rack. Cooling verification scheduled during power window; if we see >7.5kW sustained we'll throttle.

kevin: Outstanding blockers: customs hold (maria), dual-feed power run (alex/ops), PR review + merge (chris), canary playbook (sara). If we clear those, timeline still looks like canary mid-April, GA ramp in May.

maria: Filing update: escalated customs contact, added ETA cushion for mid-May if needed.

chris: I'll finish review by 15:00 PT and post status.

sara: Putting a reminder to loop in product/security for canary approval once draft is ready.

kevin: Thanks all — I'll put a 1-slide summary together using these bullets. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
